parts.t: Tsawwassen Central is easy to walk around, with shops and services close by and quick access to main roads. Browse Tsawwassen Central homes for sale below, and contact me with any questions.
Tsawwassen Central is the middle of Tsawwassen, close to the shops and services on 56 Street. You'll find older detached houses and newer townhomes, and you can do a lot of your errands on foot.

The beaches, the Boundary Bay dyke trails and Tsawwassen Mills are a short drive away. The BC Ferries terminal is close for trips to Vancouver Island and the Gulf Islands. Highway 17 takes you to Richmond and Vancouver.
